notes:
Context: Whitehaven runs regional water treatment + distribution and municipal grid control centers. Very high security posture; cannot accept any outbound egress from control networks. Team wants an operator-facing assistant (chat) that can pull incident playbooks, summarize sensor logs, and surface relevant SOPs. Also want a document search/reranking pipeline for operator consoles.

Key technical constraints (from CISO and Lead Infra Architect):
- Air-gapped on-prem deployment mandatory for production SCADA connectivity.
- HSM-backed key material, FIPS-validated crypto, hardware KMS required.
- No model or telemetry egress; optional telemetry only via customer-managed jump host.
- Retention controls: 90-day retention for logs, longer for audit archives (gov retention policy).
- SSO/SAML integration with on-prem AD/ADFS.

Performance targets discussed: chat operator flow: median latency <250ms for short guidance queries, 95th <500ms under 50 concurrent operator sessions. Embedding + rerank search: 100 qps indexing bursts, rerank <150ms. Cost sensitivity moderate — willing to pay for validated security and determinism.

POC ask: 8-week, air-gapped Private appliance in a customer lab. Deliverables: perf baseline, AD integration, HSM/KMS attestation, ops runbook, rollback plan. SE notes: will need dedicated infra engineer onsite week 1-2.

Quotes: "We cannot allow any model host outside our perimeter — keys must stay with us." — CISO.
